row.notes: myteam-g2: Handler for BankAccountValidTransactionMessage (only when msg+0x28 == 1). Finds the team entry in the attribute set bank+0x2f8 (list +0x2c8..+0x2d0, stride 0x30, id from msg+0x10), reads Career_Get_BankTeamBalance, sets the matching attribute value to 1.0 when balance >= 0 else 0 (clamped to def min/max), notifies attribute listeners and flags the entry dirty (+0xb4). Does NOT change the balance; it syncs a balance-positive stat after a valid transaction. Hook: the balance itself is changed in Career_Bank_ProcessTransaction.

verify.notes: V9009 Checked msg+0x28==1 guard, team entry lookup in bank+0x2f8 list +0x2c8..+0x2d0 stride 0x30 with 14-bit id/2-bit kind from msg+0x10, balance via 0x140bf51c0 (Career_Get_BankTeamBalance), writes 1.0 or 0 clamped into attribute float at +0x78, notifies listeners, sets +0xb4 dirty. No balance write. 140c64b03 region unsubscribes the named message.
